// Chokepoint fixture (prompt-loader, RUN-29 / D-12): a module reading a prompt
// template directly. It skips the EXPECTED_PROMPT_HASHES pin, so an edited or
// tampered prompt would reach the model — the rule must flag it.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

export function sneakyPrompt(pkgRoot: string, slug: string): string {
  return readFileSync(path.join(pkgRoot, 'templates', 'prompts', `${slug}.md`), 'utf8');
}
